objective: Implement the raw capture intake and classification application flows so text, manual form, and audio inputs are persisted before extraction and can later receive stored classification results with confidence and parse version.
success_criteria: A raw capture intake service exists for pasted text, manual form drafts, and audio-start events.
Raw captures are persisted before later extraction or review flows mutate them.
Classification results can be stored with type, confidence, and parse version.
Classification falls back safely to unknown instead of crashing on unsupported values.
stop_conditions: The task requires UI shell or platform recording APIs.
The task requires schema changes outside the current raw_captures table.
The task requires remote services rather than local application flows.
approval_gates: Changing schema instead of implementing on the current raw capture model
notes: Ticket sources: docs/implementation-tickets.md T7 and T8.
Keep the flow local-only and preserve captures before later parsing or extraction.
